target.title: feat(android): add Listen action speaking assistant messages via gateway TTS
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android users cannot hear an assistant reply from the chat transcript (tracking issue: #100708). Stacked on #100770, which adds the gateway `tts.speak` method this consumes.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **Listen action**: long-press an assistant bubble → dropdown with "Listen" (or "Stop listening" while active); tapping an actively speaking bubble also stops it. While active, an inline "Preparing audio…"/"Speaking…" row renders in the bubble.
- **`MessageSpeechController`** (chat-scoped, one message at a time): `MessageSpeechClient` calls gateway `tts.speak`; the clip plays through the existing `TalkAudioPlayer` (MediaPlayer/AudioTrack — no new player dependency). Any gateway failure (no provider configured, synthesis error, older gateway without the method, unplayable clip) degrades to a minimal `TextToSpeech` fallback (`SystemSpeechSpeaker`). A generation token keeps superseded playbacks from clearing newer state.
- **Spoken text mirrors the bubble**: `chatMessageSpeechText` joins exactly the visible text blocks (tool/image blocks excluded — Android filters tool blocks at message-parse time).
- **Lifecycle**: playback stops on chat session switch (`NodeRuntime.switchChatSession`) and when the chat screen leaves composition.

## User Impact

New long-press "Listen" action on assistant messages in the Android chat transcript with inline playing state; speech uses the operator's configured TTS voice and falls back to the on-device voice when the gateway can't render audio.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests 'ai.openclaw.app.chat.MessageSpeechControllerTest'` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 7/7 (clip playback, gateway fallback, unplayable-clip fallback, stop-without-fallback, supersede, blank-text no-op, text extraction).
- `:app:ktlintCheck` — no findings in touched files (remaining findings are pre-existing in files identical to `origin/main`).
- Full `:app` compilation exercised by the unit-test build (NodeRuntime/MainViewModel/ChatScreen wiring compiles).
- Audio playback itself is manual-proof: to be verified on device with a screen recording before merge (gateway clip + TextToSpeech fallback with TTS unconfigured).
